title: ClaimSetCandidatePromotedV1
description: Payload of the canonical, claim-bearing claim_set_candidate_promoted event. Appending this event is the sole acceptance commit point. Additive to the existing EventType enum; it does not overload AcceptCandidate. Self-contained: replay reconstructs the accepted Claim set and proof identity from this payload alone, with zero provider or extraction calls. See docs/specs/state-machine-resolver-v1-runtime-architecture.md section 5.

event_schema_version.description: Unknown values fail closed with unsupported_contract_version and render nothing as accepted.

operation_id.description: Caller-supplied durable idempotency identity, unique per (product_id, actor_id). Canonical event history is the durable operation ledger: retrying this operation returns the prior receipt with no duplicate append.

event_stream_id.description: Daemon-derived from product_id. A caller-supplied value is rejected with routing_mismatch.

base_event_position.description: Canonical event log position of the last event included in the base projection, strictly before this append. Required because appending this event changes the projection smr_base_snapshot_digest describes; without the position the digest is unverifiable on replay.

normalized_claim_set.description: NormalizedClaimSetV1 exactly as validated at proposal time. Structure and closed enums are defined by smr-claim-set-proposal.schema.json.

evidence_refs.description: May be empty. The only field permitted to be empty.

codegraph_proof_bundle.description: Optional recall-expansion evidence only. Never required for SMR closure, Claim acceptance, implementation-compliance claims, or authority. Exact carrier remains Silong-owned through issue #936.

acceptance.description: The explicit human gesture the daemon validated. MCP relayed it and never minted, normalized, ranked, approved, or persisted it.

resulting_decision.description: One promoted Claim set atomically creates exactly one Decision governance envelope. decision_id is deterministic UUIDv5 over the namespace 8f4d2c61-9a37-5b0e-8d21-4f6c7a9b3e50 and the name "claim_set_candidate_promoted/v1|" || product_id || "|" || operation_id, so a retry or concurrent submit under one operation_id resolves to one Decision.

signoff_state.description: Alpha claim-set confirm writes Decision(approved). Claims are immediately authoritative. Decision(proposed) is out of this alpha cut on this path.
